description: This file defines a report generation module for stock product history in an OpenERP/Odoo system, including classes for PDF rendering and data processing for stock movements.

classes.name: external_pdf
classes.description: A class for rendering PDF output, inheriting from report.render, encapsulating PDF data.

classes.name: report_stock
classes.description: A class implementing stock product history report logic, including data retrieval, processing, and graph generation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Generates the stock product history report, fetching stock movements, processing data, and producing a PDF report.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for external_pdf, initializes with PDF data and sets output type.

methods.name: _render
methods.description: Returns the stored PDF data for rendering.
